name: Factorio
what: Build a giant factory with belts and machines that run on their own.

fanProjects.name: Mindustry
fanProjects.what: A free factory game where your conveyor belts also feed towers that defend your base.
howToPlay: Get it free on itch.io (you can donate), or buy it on Steam to support the maker.
Play the first map in the campaign.

fanProjects.name: shapez Community Edition
fanProjects.what: A calm factory game about cutting and painting shapes. No enemies.
howToPlay: Follow the build steps on its GitHub page, or ask your AI helper to help you build it.

lovedFeatures: Place machines and conveyor belts on a grid
Mine resources and turn them into new items
Unlock new machines as you grow
